_comment: Single source of truth for gate commands (CLAUDE.md links here, it does not restate them). Run via `node .agent/tools/run-gate.mjs <gate> --unit <ID>`. `na` requires a written reason; a gate that is neither runnable nor N/A blocks work rather than being skipped. min_tests rejects vacuous passes. Rationale for N/A entries: .agent/decisions/D-001-toolchain.md.

typecheck.na: plain JavaScript, no type checker in a zero-dependency project (D-001)

build.na: no build step; index.html loads script.js directly (D-001)
